-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem applyOne_addNodeJ (I O : GSet w64) (x : w64) (hx : x ≠ W64 0) : applyOne (addNodeCC x) (jst
    I O ∅ ∅) = some (jst (<[x := ()]>I) O ∅ ∅)

theorem simpleFold_step (l : List ConfChangeSingleM) (s s' : CCState) (j : Nat) (c :
    ConfChangeSingleM) (Hc : l[j]? = some c) (H : simpleFold l s = some s') : ∃ sj sj1, simpleFold
    (List.take j l) s = some sj ∧ simpleM [c] sj = some sj1 ∧ simpleFold (List.take (j + 1) l) s =
    some sj1

def restoreSimpleOps (vo v l ln : List w64) : List ConfChangeSingleM :=
  if vo = [] then restoreInCC [] v l ln else restoreOutCC vo

theorem restoreM_wf (vo v l ln : List w64) (al : Bool) (Hwf : CSWf vo v l ln) : restoreM vo v l ln
    al = some (cfgStateC (csCfgM vo v l ln al))

theorem applyOne_addStaged (I O L N : GSet w64) (x : w64) (hx : x ≠ W64 0) (hO : x ∈ O) (hI : ¬x ∈
    I) (hL : ¬x ∈ L) : applyOne (addLearnerCC x) (jst I O L N) = some (jst I O L <[x := ()]>N)

theorem enterJointM_restoreIn (vo v l ln : List w64) (al : Bool) (Hwf : CSWf vo v l ln) (hvo : vo ≠
    []) : enterJointM al (restoreInCC vo v l ln) (cfgState (listToSet vo) ∅) = some (cfgStateC
    (csCfgM vo v l ln al))

theorem applyAll_removes (vo : List w64) (I O : GSet w64) (H : ∀ (x : w64), x ∈ vo → x ≠ W64 0 ∧ x ∈
    O) : ∃ I', (∀ (k : w64), k ∈ I' ↔ k ∈ I ∧ ¬k ∈ vo) ∧ applyAll (List.map removeNodeCC vo) (jst I
    O ∅ ∅) = some (jst I' O ∅ ∅)

theorem simpleFold_append (l1 l2 : List ConfChangeSingleM) (s : CCState) : simpleFold (l1 ++ l2) s =
    (simpleFold l1 s).bind (simpleFold l2)

theorem simpleFold_restoreIn (v l : List w64) (hv : v ≠ []) (H0 : ∀ (x : w64), x ∈ v ∨ x ∈ l → x ≠
    W64 0) (Hl : ∀ (x : w64), x ∈ l → ¬x ∈ v) : simpleFold (restoreInCC [] v l []) (cfgState ∅ ∅) =
    some (cfgState (listToSet v) (listToSet l))

def restoreM (vo v l ln : List w64) (al : Bool) : Option CCState :=
  if vo = [] then simpleFold (restoreSimpleOps vo v l ln) (cfgState ∅ ∅)
  else (simpleFold (restoreSimpleOps vo v l ln) (cfgState ∅ ∅)).bind (enterJointM al (restoreInCC vo v l ln))

theorem applyAll_addNodesJ (v : List w64) (I O : GSet w64) (H : ∀ (x : w64), x ∈ v → x ≠ W64 0) : ∃
    I', (∀ (k : w64), k ∈ I' ↔ k ∈ I ∨ k ∈ v) ∧ applyAll (List.map addNodeCC v) (jst I O ∅ ∅) = some
    (jst I' O ∅ ∅)

theorem applyAll_addStaged (ln : List w64) (I O L N : GSet w64) (H : ∀ (x : w64), x ∈ ln → x ≠ W64 0
    ∧ x ∈ O ∧ ¬x ∈ I ∧ ¬x ∈ L) : ∃ N', (∀ (k : w64), k ∈ N' ↔ k ∈ N ∨ k ∈ ln) ∧ applyAll (List.map
    addLearnerCC ln) (jst I O L N) = some (jst I O L N')

theorem applyOne_remove (I O : GSet w64) (x : w64) (hx : x ≠ W64 0) (hO : x ∈ O) : applyOne
    (removeNodeCC x) (jst I O ∅ ∅) = some (jst (GMap.delete x I) O ∅ ∅)

theorem simpleFold_addLearners (l : List w64) (V L : GSet w64) (hne : V ≠ ∅) (H0 : ∀ (x : w64), x ∈
    l → x ≠ W64 0 ∧ ¬x ∈ V) (Hd : ∀ (k : w64), k ∈ L → ¬k ∈ V) : ∃ L', (∀ (k : w64), k ∈ L' ↔ k ∈ L
    ∨ k ∈ l) ∧ (∀ (k : w64), k ∈ L' → ¬k ∈ V) ∧ simpleFold (List.map addLearnerCC l) (cfgState V L)
    = some (cfgState V L')

theorem simpleFold.eq_def (x✝ : List ConfChangeSingleM) (x✝¹ : CCState) : simpleFold x✝ x✝¹ = match
    x✝, x✝¹ with | [], s => some s | c :: cs, s => (simpleM [c] s).bind (simpleFold cs)

def removeNodeCC (id : w64) : ConfChangeSingleM :=
  { Type' := W32 1, NodeId' := id }

theorem applyOne_addLearnerJ (I O L : GSet w64) (x : w64) (hx : x ≠ W64 0) (hI : ¬x ∈ I) (hO : ¬x ∈
    O) : applyOne (addLearnerCC x) (jst I O L ∅) = some (jst I O <[x := ()]>L ∅)

theorem applyAll_addLearnersJ (l : List w64) (I O L : GSet w64) (H : ∀ (x : w64), x ∈ l → x ≠ W64 0
    ∧ ¬x ∈ I ∧ ¬x ∈ O) : ∃ L', (∀ (k : w64), k ∈ L' ↔ k ∈ L ∨ k ∈ l) ∧ applyAll (List.map
    addLearnerCC l) (jst I O L ∅) = some (jst I O L' ∅)

def simpleFold : List ConfChangeSingleM → CCState → Option CCState :=
  List.brecOn (motive := fun x => CCState → Option CCState) x✝¹ simpleFold._f x✝

theorem gset_ne_empty_of_mem {X : GSet w64} {x : w64} (h : x ∈ X) : X ≠ ∅

def jst (I O L N : GSet w64) : CCState :=
  { cfg := { incoming := I, outgoing := O, learners := L, learnersNext := N, autoLeave := false },
    prs := cfgFlags (I ∪ O) L }

theorem simpleFold_addNodes (v : List w64) (V L : GSet w64) (H0 : ∀ (x : w64), x ∈ v → x ≠ W64 0 ∧
    ¬x ∈ L) (Hd : ∀ (k : w64), k ∈ L → ¬k ∈ V) : ∃ V', (∀ (k : w64), k ∈ V' ↔ k ∈ V ∨ k ∈ v) ∧ (∀ (k
    : w64), k ∈ L → ¬k ∈ V') ∧ simpleFold (List.map addNodeCC v) (cfgState V L) = some (cfgState V'
    L)

theorem restoreM_cfgInv {vo v l ln : List w64} {al : Bool} {s : CCState} (H : restoreM vo v l ln al
    = some s) : CfgInv s

def restoreInCC (vo v l ln : List w64) : List ConfChangeSingleM :=
  List.map removeNodeCC vo ++ List.map addNodeCC v ++ List.map addLearnerCC l ++ List.map addLearnerCC ln

def restoreOutCC (vo : List w64) : List ConfChangeSingleM :=
  List.map addNodeCC vo
